item.text: The parser has a usable template boundary check, but its AST walker is built for variable interpolation. I’ll keep matcher validation separate so `email.local` continues to work in `Variable()` while matcher expressions enforce their own argument rules.
The matcher implementation passes the focused tests. I’m reviewing the edge cases now, especially error wording, raw regexp behavior, and how static text around a template is matched.

item.text: During review, I found that the interpolation parser’s bracket pattern would reject regex quantifiers such as `{2}` inside a quoted argument. Matcher parsing now accepts those arguments and still rejects malformed template boundaries. The focused tests pass.

item.text:
Implemented matcher expressions in [parse.go](/app/lib/utils/parse/parse.go), including literal, wildcard, raw regexp, `regexp.match`, and `regexp.not_match` support. The parser validates function calls, rejects matcher functions in `Variable()`, and preserves static prefixes and suffixes. Added focused coverage in [parse_test.go](/app/lib/utils/parse/parse_test.go).

The parse package tests and `git diff --check` pass. The adjacent utils suite has one unrelated failure: a certificate fixture expired in 2021.
